reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that defers tool schemas from the model context and exposes them through on-demand search or name-based activation without implementing or proxying the underlying tools.

summaries.zh: 通过按需搜索和激活来延迟工具模式加载，帮助智能体控制可见工具集合并减少模型上下文中的工具信息。
summaries.en: Defers tool schemas from the model context and lets agents discover and activate registered tools on demand.

capabilities: Restricts which registered tools are visible to an agent
Searches and activates deferred tools on demand
Intercepts direct calls to inactive deferred tools
